notes: Offline accounting component only. No API client or automatic spend is enabled by this file.

All future runs share one project ledger. Run keys identify preregistered configurations/repetitions, never retries. Case keys remain stable across runs. Request limits apply per case/run; total budget and distinct-case limit are global.
Candidate models are not a quality selection. Verify account access and current prices before sending.
Reserve the maximum input rate including a 30-minute cache write, plus the entire output cap including reasoning.
The sender must bound/count the fully serialized input including tools and history; reserve before each request and mark sent before dispatch.
All requests, tool round trips, revisions and retries consume limits. Unknown outcomes remain reserved across restarts.
Only requests proven not sent may release their reservation. Provider usage is settled exactly; overruns are recorded and freeze new reservations.
No automatic top-ups, model substitutions, Fast mode, long contexts, extended cache retention or paid hosted tools.
VND cost is a planning estimate; tax, payment fees, actual FX and provider billing need separate reconciliation.
